semantic.justification: Canonical header borrows the one font class; no second implementation. Task135 preserves the five native SvxFontItem fields and original value defaults/constructors/copies/setters/equality/hash using existing SAL/o3tl. Writer state and ODF consumers use the single shared value owner; browser presentation and resource aliases stay at their existing boundaries. Native Any FontDescriptor, localized presentation, full font/device/config services and Calc DocPool/document/UI/ODS remain pending. Existing status/history and conscious save/open/recovery deviations are retained; no broad parity promotion or custom lifetime engine. The header reexports SvxFontItem and declares no duplicate local symbol.
